findings.title: Reject traversal names and prevent target overwrites.
findings.rationale:
name can contain ../ segments. A caller can write to or truncate files outside /var/uploads/ that the service account can access. This is arbitrary service-account file modification, not only an upload-directory issue.

Reject empty names and path separators. Create files with exclusive-create semantics so an existing file is not truncated.

findings.title: Close files and remove failed uploads.
findings.rationale:
f is never closed. Repeated uploads can exhaust file descriptors. If ReadFrom fails, the partial file remains and can be treated as a complete upload.

Close the file before sending HTTP 200. Remove the target when copying or closing fails.

findings.title: Synchronize count updates.
findings.rationale: h.count++ is a non-atomic read-modify-write operation. Concurrent upload goroutines can lose increments. Lock h.mu around every read and write of h.count.
